name: 057_coinbase_premium_follow
hypothesis: Coinbase is where US institutions and ETF-related flow buy spot; Binance is mostly offshore retail and derivatives. When US spot buyers pay up, the coin trades at a premium on Coinbase relative to Binance, and that buying is persistent (large orders are worked over hours to days), so price on Binance follows. When the premium jumps (its z-score against its own last n bars crosses above +z) go long on the Binance perp; when it collapses (below -z), go short. Counterparty: offshore traders who have not yet seen the US flow. Pre-registered in PLAN.md section 25: z threshold, lookback and target are chosen on TRAIN only; ATR 3 stop, out after 48 h, 4-bar cooldown. Prior: low to medium-low; this is the first data source in the project that comes from outside Binance.
